dimensions.assessment: Applies nationally to federal courts and taxpayers involved in federal tax law litigation, mediated through the National Taxpayer Advocate.
dimensions.evidence: National Taxpayer Advocate may appear as amicus curiae in any action brought in a court of the United States related to Federal tax law

dimensions.assessment: Provides new legal standing for an administrative official to participate in federal litigation without altering underlying tax liabilities directly.
dimensions.evidence: A court of the United States may grant the application of the National Taxpayer Advocate to appear

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state any federal spending, revenue, or economic effects.
Makes a targeted statutory amendment to the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 regarding legal participation authority.
dimensions.evidence: Section 7803(c)(2) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by adding at the end the following new subparagraph

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent legal right and authority taking effect on the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendment made by this section shall take effect on the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Estimated frequency of appearances or potential legal cost impacts
importance_detail.rationale: The Taxpayer Advocate Participation Act authorizes the National Taxpayer Advocate to appear as amicus curiae and submit briefs in federal courts regarding tax cases that broadly affect taxpayer rights, and requires federal courts to permit such appearances.
